faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Discover quick and comprehensive answers to common questions about our platform, services, and features.

items.question: Is it compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux?
items.answer:
Yes, Whoa IDE works on all modern systems supporting Neovim. It is regularly tested on macOS (Apple Silicon), Ubuntu, and WSL on Windows.

Requirements: Neovim 0.9+, Git, and an Internet connection to install plugins.

items.question: Can I add my own plugins?
items.answer:
Absolutely. Whoa IDE is modular and built to be extended without breaking the base structure.

You can add plugins via `lua/plugins/user.lua` or create your own custom modules.

items.question: Is it beginner-friendly for Neovim users?
items.answer:
Yes, totally. Whoa IDE is designed to lower the learning curve of Neovim: everything is preconfigured, documented, and made for a quick start.

If you're coming from VS Code, you’ll find a familiar experience.

items.question: Who maintains Whoa IDE?
items.answer:
Whoa IDE is developed and maintained by Ugolin Ollé, a full-stack developer passionate about productivity tools.

The project is open-source and regularly updated to follow the Neovim ecosystem.
